data.command: What web server are you running?

data.text:
We're running the fantastic nginx/1.24.0 web server, which is a great choice for serving a variety of content, including static websites and even some dynamic ones with the help of our favorite programming languages like PHP and Python.

Nginx is currently listening on port 80 (http) and port 443 (https) for secure connections, and it's configured to serve content from the /var/www/html directory. We've also set up some reverse proxy rules to pass traffic from the outside world to our application servers, which are running on a mix of Node.js and Python frameworks.

By the way, our server is running on Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS, with kernel 5.15.0-91, which provides a nice balance of performance and security. We've also made sure to keep our Nginx installation up to date with the latest patches and security fixes, just to keep those pesky hackers at bay!

Want to know more about how we're running our services or maybe something about the firewall rules?
